pirouline.com: 74. The gap: framing.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But other sites can frame the page.

Lesson: Send frame-ancestors 'self' in the CSP, or X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, so other sites cannot frame your pages.

postobon.com: 49. The gap: form labels.

Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 25 form controls have no label.

Lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.

monsterenergy.com: 71. The gap: link names.

Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But links must have discernible text.

Lesson: Give every link text that says where it goes. An icon alone needs an aria-label.
